verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a TOTP/HOTP one-time-passcode generator. Building, versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations is outside its product category, and the evidence shows no automation capability at all. Code sync, QR export, and edit/delete of entries are credential management, not automation version control, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
